concern: These bindings cover only the four approved resumed batches. A further interruption cannot reset the budget or silently add another predecessor; it requires another explicit ledger.

invocation_receipt_contract.batch_bindings: Four exact resumed batch descriptions, with plan/start and predecessor file hashes.
invocation_receipt_contract.jobs[].pass_accounting: Every job carries its predecessor ledger. An eligible frozen/existing job also carries resumed_passes, cumulative_passes, resumed_run_id, and resumed_started_sha256.
invocation_receipt_contract.snapshot_manifest: Unchanged completion-judgment-evidence-v1, bound to the resumed terminal only.

rules: A previously started job must have one interrupted predecessor pass and a resumed batch limit of two passes.
An unstarted job must have no predecessor pass events and a resumed batch limit of three passes.
A pending/pending_fields terminal qualifies only when predecessor passes plus completed resumed passes equal exactly three.
A complete/complete terminal can qualify sooner, within the three-pass lifetime limit.
Pause, circuit break, failure, conflicting metadata, or later job events prevent freezing. The original interrupted batch never qualifies as final.
Every eligible resumed pass must preserve the source identity and field denominator. Completed-field counts cannot fall below the predecessor count.
The helper uses the existing freezer and its nonblocking lock. Complete evidence uses its explicit final path; exhausted incomplete evidence uses its explicit partial path.
Existing manifests must validate against the exact resumed terminal, pinned source, and predecessor ledger. No file or label is overwritten.
A real freeze requires a new invocation receipt. The receipt preserves predecessor started/events/report paths and full hashes, resumed passes, and cumulative passes.
The existing evidence manifest schema and all production code remain unchanged. The resumed terminal snapshot can record passes=2; the helper receipt proves the predecessor plus resume total.
status: Prepared and synthetically tested. No real resumed event log or label content was read; no real evidence was frozen.

exit_codes.0: No rejected/interrupted job; active or lock-busy jobs can still remain.
exit_codes.1: A rejected/interrupted job or pinned metadata failure.

usage.receipt_rule: Use a new receipt filename each time. One invocation does one scan and schedules nothing.

validation.real_preparation_access: Pinned original/resumed plans and starts; closed predecessor reports/events; helper and dependency source hashes.
